name: response_ir_chat_stream_usage_gemini
_comment: Same upstream usage script toward Gemini SSE: terminal usageMetadata carries prompt 12, candidates 7, cached 4, total 12+7=19 with ordinary STOP. No [DONE] sentinel on Gemini streams.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "gem-chat"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
